channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio não descarta dar cargo ao pai e diz que Eduardo não será chanceler
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro did not rule out appointing his father, Jair Bolsonaro, to a government position and ruled out Eduardo Bolsonaro as chancellor.

item.title: Flávio poupa Nunes Marques e ataca Moraes em entrevista no JN
item.description: In an interview with Jornal Nacional, Flávio Bolsonaro attacked Minister Alexandre de Moraes and avoided criticizing Kassio Nunes Marques, maintaining a low-controversy strategy with the former Justice Minister. This approach reflects caution to preserve ties with conservative sectors.

item.title: Flávio nega que mudará fim da 6x1: 'Todos os direitos trabalhistas estão garantidos'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, stated he will not change the constitutional amendment eliminating the 6x1 work schedule, ensuring all labor rights remain protected.

item.title: Flávio volta a usar cola na mão em sabatina e repete estratégia do pai
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) once again used a 'cheat sheet' on his hand during a town hall, mimicking a communication strategy previously used by his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The word this time was 'motoboy'. This tactic reinforces the informal and polarizing style of the campaign.

item.title: Entrevista de Flávio à Globo é acompanhada por panelaços em capitais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's interview on TV Globo was followed by panelaços in several capitals, organized via social media and supported by federal deputy André Janones. The protests reflect a digital strategy linked to Lula's support and mobilization against the PL presidential candidate.

item.title: Flávio diz que não vai desvincular reajuste do mínimo e nem alterar pisos de saúde e educação
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he will keep the minimum wage adjustment above inflation, without linking it to a percentage and without amending the Constitution to change health and education funding floors. The remarks were made during a TV Globo interview.

item.title: Flávio diz ser contra reeleição: 'Só preciso de um mandato'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he does not seek re-election as president, saying he 'only needs one term.' He participated in a TV Globo interview conducted by journalist Renata Lo Prete.

item.title: Flávio diz que seu plano fiscal envolve imóveis “abandonados” da União
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposed gathering abandoned public properties into a management fund and securitizing them to raise R$ 200 billion, avoiding cuts to pensions and spending on health and education. He also suggested abolishing ministries, using AI against corruption, and securitizing debt, though some proposals involve uncertainties such as oil exploration in the equatorial margin.

item.title: Flávio descarta cargo a Eduardo, mas não ao pai: “Não está no radar”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro will not be appointed as Minister of Foreign Affairs if he wins the presidency. Regarding his father, Jair Bolsonaro, he did not rule out the possibility of a government position, but said the topic was never discussed.

item.title: Flávio é contra fim da 6 X 1 e vai “destruir” Farmácia Popular, diz Lula
item.description: Lula criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming he will 'destroy' achievements like the 6 X 1 work schedule, universities, federal institutes, and the Popular Pharmacy. The president also attacked TV Globo for a lunch meeting with his opponent. Congress approved the proposal ending the 6 X 1 schedule, which Flávio supported after initially criticizing it.

item.title: Moro diz que fim da escala 6x1 não é pauta dos trabalhadores e minimiza efeito para Lula
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL) states that the Senate's approval of the end of the 6x1 workweek scale will not benefit Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) campaign, viewing the measure as a workers' agenda and downplaying its electoral impact.

item.title: Flávio usa relógio do pai, Jair Bolsonaro, em sabatina do JN
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro wore a watch during a Jornal Nacional interview that is identical to one used by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, while in office. His press team confirmed he received the watch in January after being chosen as Jair's electoral successor in 2025. The low-cost timepiece was also worn by Jair during official events such as the 2023 swearing-in ceremony.

item.title: Flávio diz que maior ajuste fiscal do Brasil é a derrota de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that Lula's defeat is Brazil's biggest fiscal adjustment and pledged to keep the minimum wage increase above inflation and support ending the 6×1 work schedule. He denied adopting proposals attributed to his team and accused Lula of spreading information about his administration.

item.title: Empresário que fez repasses a fundo de 'Dark Horse' diz em delação que tentou reaver valores, mas não conseguiu
item.description: Antônio Carlos Freixo Junior, a businessman from Minas Gerais, claimed in a plea bargain that he transferred $12.3 million to the Dark Horse fund at the request of Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro, unaware of the funds' purpose. He attempted to recover the money upon detecting irregularities but was unsuccessful. The Federal Police challenge the credibility of his account and requested an extension of the investigation from the Supreme Court.

item.title: Lo Prete rebate fala de Flávio sobre Master: “Não está confirmado pela PF”
item.description: Renata Lo Prete refuted Flávio Bolsonaro's claim about alleged bribes involving Lula, stating the accusation is not confirmed by the Federal Police. During a TV Globo interview, Flávio referenced Daniel Vorcaro's reports on 10% kickbacks to release pension fund investments from Banco Master, but was cut off by the host.

item.title: O que está por trás das guinadas de Flávio e Lula durante a campanha
item.description: The electoral race between Lula and Flávio has led both to revise traditional stances, such as supporting the end of the 6×1 work schedule and lowering the age of criminal responsibility, in search of votes in a tightly contested scenario. According to political scientist Rodrigo Prando, these shifts reflect the need to expand electoral appeal in a race defined by the candidates' technical tie.

item.title: Flávio promete corte de 10 ministérios: "Economia de R$ 200 bilhões"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro pledged to eliminate at least 10 ministries and cut spending by R$200 billion annually, echoing his father's administration. In a TV Globo interview, he criticized Lula’s management of state companies and emphasized fighting corruption.

item.title: Na Globo, Flávio diz que Eduardo não será chanceler e evita responder se daria cargo ao pai: 'Nunca tratou disso'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoided saying whether his father, Jair Bolsonaro, would hold a government position but denied that Eduardo Bolsonaro would be chancellor. In a Globo interview, he defended left-wing economic policies and avoided detailing the R$200 billion budget cuts.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula fazem panelaço contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Supporters of Lula carried out protests in multiple cities before Flávio Bolsonaro's interview on the Jornal Nacional. The mobilization was called by federal deputy André Janones on social media, with demonstrations recorded in SP, RJ, CE, DF, MG, PR, RS, and PE.

item.title: As soluções apresentadas por Flávio Bolsonaro para cortar custos da máquina pública
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated in an interview that he will not cut social benefits and proposed reducing public spending by cutting ministries, fighting corruption in state-owned companies, and auctioning off abandoned properties. He criticized Lula's management and suggested revising the federal debt to increase revenue.

item.title: As novas pesquisas e a possibilidade de virada de Lula, segundo cientista político
item.description: The race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro remains tight, with the senator leading by a few points within the margin of error. Political scientist Rodrigo Prando emphasizes that the outcome depends on electoral history but believes Lula can reverse the score. The PT campaign is likely to determine the final result.

item.title: "O maior ajuste fiscal que o Brasil pode fazer é tirar o Lula", diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated, in a live interview on Jornal Nacional, that removing Lula from office would be the biggest fiscal adjustment possible and denied plans to cut pensions, privatize state companies, or eliminate spending floors in health and education.

item.title: Panelaços no Rio e em SP marcam sabatina de Flávio na Globo
item.description: Protesters in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro staged pan-pounding demonstrations during Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's interview on TV Globo, a protest linked to Lula supporters. The actions took place on the night of Friday the 16th and lasted throughout the broadcast.

item.title: Moradores do DF fazem “panelaço” durante sabatina de Flávio Bolsonaro no JN
item.description: Residents of Brasília held a noise protest during Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) interview on TV Globo, opposing the candidate. The protest was organized by federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) via social media calls to action.

item.title: VÍDEOS: Renata Lo Prete entrevista Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato à Presidência pelo PL
item.description: Renata Lo Prete interviews Flávio Bolsonaro, PL candidate for the 2026 Brazilian presidency, discussing minimum wage, health, education, and fiscal adjustment. The content includes criticisms of the STF, debates on re-election and judicial reform, and election-related news like Meta's actions and political investigations.

item.title: Panelaços em capitais e cidades brasileiras são registrados durante sabatina de Flávio Bolsonaro; vídeos
item.description: During a Globo interview with Flávio Bolsonaro, Brazilian cities saw pan protests organized by deputy André Janones. The TSE allowed the 'Lula Army' WhatsApp group to resume after technical review found no fake news in its messages.

item.title: Lula ataca a TV Globo ao dizer que emissora tem raiva dele por ter prendido Vorcaro
item.description: At a campaign event in Minas Gerais, Lula accused TV Globo of being 'angry' with him for having arrested Daniel Vorcaro, citing alleged media influence over Flávio Bolsonaro's allies. The PT candidate also reiterated left-wing economic critiques without detailing the accusations.

item.title: Lula põe Globo sob suspeição por almoço com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: President Lula stated during a campaign event in Ipatinga that he will treat Globo with suspicion following a lunch hosted by the media group's leadership with Flávio Bolsonaro in Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é alvo de ‘panelaço’ durante entrevista na ‘Globo’
item.description: During an interview with TV Globo, Flávio Bolsonaro faced a 'panelaço' protest in several cities including São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador, and Belo Horizonte. The movement was encouraged by federal deputy André Janones using the hashtag #DilmaSeraVingada.

item.title: Bairros de São Paulo têm panelaço por sabatina de Flávio Bolsonaro no JN
item.description: Residents of several São Paulo neighborhoods held pot-banging protests before Flávio Bolsonaro's interview on the national news, following a call by federal deputy André Janones. The demonstration was a protest against the PL candidate, who faces Lula in the October 25 runoff.

item.title: Dark Horse: Delator entregou à PF planilha, contratos e mensagens com advogado de Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Witness Antonio Carlos Freixo Júnior handed over spreadsheets, currency contracts, and messages with Eduardo Bolsonaro's lawyer to federal authorities, linked to the funding of the film 'Dark Horse' and Flávio Bolsonaro's involvement.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro promete manter fim da escala 6x1, diz que só quer um mandato e que 'não está no radar' ter o pai em eventual governo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated in an interview with Globo that he will maintain the end of the 6x1 work schedule, emphasized he seeks only one presidential term, and ruled out appointing his father, Jair Bolsonaro, to any role in a potential administration. On economic policy, he pledged to keep minimum wage and pension adjustments tied to inflation, preserve spending floors for health and education, and cut at least ten ministries as part of fiscal adjustment.

item.title: Na Globo, Flávio reclama de ‘terrorismo’ de Lula e promete manter aumento real do salário mínimo e fim da escala 6x1
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied fiscal austerity measures in an interview with Globo and promised to maintain the real value of the minimum wage and end the 6x1 work schedule. He accused Lula of promoting 'terrorism' and did not detail the proposed R$200 billion budget cuts. Datafolha poll shows a technical tie between the two candidates.

item.title: Caso Master: o que as mensagens de Vorcaro revelam sobre Gabriela Prioli
item.description: During a Globo interview, Lula downplayed the Banco Master case, involving messages from Daniel Vorcaro and contracts from Vivianne Barci's office, attributing the allegations to the opposition. The messages, released by Estadão, suggest Vorcaro advised Lula's transition team. The case raises questions about corporate influence during the government transition.

item.title: TSE tem maioria para Meta assegurar isonomia entre Flávio e Lula nas redes
item.description: The TSE formed a majority to ensure parity between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) on Meta's social media platforms, following a decision by Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze.

item.title: Lula diz que “Globo” está contra ele após fim de bets e prisão de Vorcaro
item.description: At a campaign rally in Ipatinga, Lula accused TV Globo of opposing his candidacy, linking the alleged media stance to the end of horse racing subsidies, the 6x1 work schedule, and the arrest of Daniel Vorcaro. He claimed the network is under suspicion and referenced Trump, Milei, and the Master case as electoral opponents.

item.title: Dark Horse: PF pede mais 90 dias para investigação sobre filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police requested an additional 90 days from the Supreme Court to investigate the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', which depicts Jair Bolsonaro, amid suspicions of irregularities involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro. The investigation, part of the Master case, probes money laundering, currency flight, and organized crime.

item.title: Derrite é o preferido de Flávio Bolsonaro para a Segurança Pública
item.description: Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) is the leading name to head the Ministry of Public Security, if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the 2026 elections. So far, there has been no formal invitation between the two, according to sources close to them. Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) is also mentioned as a potential candidate for the position.

item.title: PF pede mais 90 dias para investigar Dark Horse
item.description: The Federal Police requested a 90-day extension to investigate the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic about Jair Bolsonaro, with suspicions of money laundering and currency evasion. Among those investigated is Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, and the case involves approximately R$134 million and $12.3 million transferred abroad.

item.title: Advogado do Master tentou aproximar Daniel Vorcaro de esposa do ministro Cueva
item.description: Fábio Medina, lawyer for Banco Master, offered Daniel Vorcaro an invitation to a Brasília event promising contact with Justice Minister Cueva and his wife. Vorcaro declined due to family commitments, missing the event. Investigation reveals the minister's wife had no connection to Banco Master's business deals.

item.title: TSE forma maioria para determinar que Meta não interfira em conteúdo de Flávio e Lula
item.description: TSE ruled that Meta must not interfere with electoral content distribution of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, upholding a decision by Justice Marco Aurélio. The ruling was supported by three ministers, with a daily fine of $100,000 for non-compliance. The lawsuit alleges preferential content creation by Meta AI.

item.title: Dark Horse: Delator relata fraude em pagamento a fundo ligado a Eduardo Bolsonaro nos EUA
item.description: Businessman Antônio Carlos Freixo Júnior, in his plea bargain, told the Federal Police that a $12.3 million transfer to a U.S. fund allegedly to finance the movie 'Dark Horse' involved fraud and was disguised as a real estate investment. The money allegedly originated from Banco Master and is linked to Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro, both under investigation in the case.

item.title: Lula envia nos próximos dias PEC do ônibus de graça aos fins de semana
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will send a PEC to Congress in the coming days proposing free weekend bus fares, funded by parliamentary amendments. The measure, which requires debate with lawmakers, was announced before the second round of the presidential election. Campaign coordinator Camilo Santana emphasized the issue's relevance to urban mobility.

item.title: A campanha de Lula e o panelaço na entrevista de Flávio Bolsonaro na Globo
item.description: Supporters of Lula were called to stage a pot-banging protest during Flávio Bolsonaro's interview on Globo, but opposing guidance emerged, questioning the protest's effectiveness and impact. The debate reflects polarization between followers of the two leaders. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Zanin relata ação do PSD para tentar restabelecer segundo turno no Rio
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin was randomly assigned to oversee a lawsuit filed by the PSD party aiming to restore the second-round gubernatorial election in Rio de Janeiro, scheduled for October 25th. The lawsuit challenges the legality of the move eliminating the runoff.

item.title: Lula diz que “Globo” está sob “suspeição” após almoço com Flávio
item.description: President Lula claimed TV Globo is under suspicion after Senator Flávio Bolsonaro had lunch with the network's executives before an interview. He accused the media of discontent with government measures such as the gambling crackdown and the end of the 6x1 work schedule, as well as the arrest of businessman Daniel Vorcaro. Lula leveraged the episode to rally support against the right-wing ahead of the reelection race.

item.title: Meta diz não interferir em eleições no Brasil e descreve problemas como 'incidentes técnicos'
item.description: Meta released a statement asserting it did not interfere in the Brazilian elections and labeled as 'technical incidents' the episodes cited by a Folha report. The company found no intentional misconduct in its electoral activities.

item.title: Meta cita ‘falha’, mas nega interferência nas eleições brasileiras
item.description: Meta denied interference in the Brazilian elections following reports of technical failures that affected the distribution of Lula's campaign content on WhatsApp and Instagram, including issues with view counts and blocked promotions. The TSE banned the platform from restricting political-election content, requiring prior human analysis to disable candidates' advertising accounts.

item.title: Debate na Band no segundo turno: o que esperar do primeiro confronto entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The first runoff debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro takes place on Band, with Lula two points behind (45%) and Flávio leading (47%). Flávio initially refused to attend but confirmed after Lula's statement, vowing to 'rub the truth in his face' during the clash. Coverage will be live with post-debate analysis.

item.title: TSE tem maioria para manter decisão que proíbe Meta de limitar alcance de conteúdo político e favorecer candidatos
item.description: The TSE ruled that Meta cannot restrict the reach of political content or favor candidates such as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The decision aims to ensure equal treatment in content distribution and AI use during the election. Justice Bellizze emphasized preventive measures but found no evidence of deliberate manipulation by the company.
